text: All relocations shall be applied before bootstrap; constant ROM shall contain final values and dynamic globals reside only in writable ordinary RAM. Dynamic linking/rebasing/native OS executable assumptions and relocation-time factory execution shall be absent. Relocation details shall follow [0013](0013_objects_and_static_linking.md).
